meaning:
συν-κύπτω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Job.9:27 (עָזַב), Sir.12:11 19:26 * ;]
1. to bend forwards (Arist., al.).
2. to be bowed down: Luk.13:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.
